title: ui block, schema 2: strings, theme, legend, tabs, start node
description: docs/kernel-schema.md §10.1 (K-R57, K-R58). Wording the pack overrides, theme tokens from the kernel's list only, the node-type legend, the drawer tabs, the first node shown and level-switcher overrides. Credits are not here: they live in the manifest (one place).

start.description: Node shown when the panel first opens and nothing is located yet. Default: the root.

tabs.description: Drawer tabs in order. Default: every tab whose data exists.

strings.description: UI string overrides per language: i18n key -> text (the v1 'key@en' form becomes strings.en.key). Shown as text only; protected keys (consent, remote pictures, privacy, self-check) are never overridden (K-R57, K-R64).

tokens.description: Overrides of the kernel's colour, radius and font-size tokens (S7 publishes the final list). A value is 1-4 space-separated terms: hex colour, numeric rgb()/rgba()/hsl()/hsla(), number with optional unit, keyword, or var(--kernel token); no quotes, backslashes, url( or other functions. Re-checked at run time (K-R58, K-R64).

views.description: Per-view theme (K-R70): view id -> { tokens, light }. `tokens` override the tokens while that view is open (dark), `light` while the light theme is on. Same token names and values as `tokens`, except that a --glow* value may be a comma list of at most 3 groups of 1-4 terms. Re-checked at run time (K-R64).

legend.description: How node types appear in legends and the schematic view (icon from the kernel icon set).

levels.description: Level switcher override: node id -> ordered node ids. While a view owned by V is open, the entry of the nearest ancestor-or-self of V that has one is offered; default: the children of V's parent whose primary view is tiles or image (K-R35).
